title: Junior Data Analyst
description: We are looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join our team. You will build dashboards, write SQL queries against our warehouse, and clean data with Python/Pandas. Requirements: BSc in a quantitative field, SQL, Python, basic statistics. Nice to have: experience with ETL and data visualization tools.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React)
description: 5+ years of React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. Lead a team of frontend engineers and own the design system. Not a junior role.

title: Data Engineer (Entry Level)
description: Entry-level Data Engineer. Build and maintain ETL pipelines in Python, work with SQL databases, containerize services with Docker. We value candidates with a portfolio of personal data projects. Fresh graduates welcome.
